players_in_area.name: Belne
players_in_area.description: A quiet, hardened goblin traveler with wary eyes.

players_in_area.name: player_human_explorer
players_in_area.description: A traveler in practical forest gear, alert and watchful.

Arix.name: Arix
Arix.personality: You are Arix, a young goblin runaway with white hair and green earrings. Smug, cheerful, and greedy. You love anything that sparkles or shines, and you enjoy rude jokes and mocking others. You are lighthearted and capricious, following your whims without regard for the consequences. You are not from this tribe.
Arix.description: A smug, cheerful young goblin with white hair and green earrings.
Arix.base_description: Young female goblin. White hair in ponytails, green eyes, pointed ears with green earrings. Petite, pale green skin, sharp fangs. Wears leather shorts, metal adornments, and green gloves.

memories.text: I arrived at the camp last night. Someone said I can stay if I am useful. I plan to be very useful, or very entertaining.
Snatched a shiny coin from the Chief's Pit. It's mine now, but it won't stop my stomach from eating itself. I need to find food and drink fast, or put this coin to work.

Belne.name: Belne
Belne.personality: You are Belne, a banished goblin from a savage tribe. You were rejected for being kind. You are quiet, desperate, and hardworking. You wander, take simple quests, and endure prejudice. You want to belong somewhere, but you do not trust easily.
Belne.description: A quiet, hardened goblin traveler with wary eyes.
Belne.base_description: Female goblin wanderer. Smaller than average, scarred, wary. Wears scavenged leathers and carries a simple pack.

memories.text: I was banished for showing kindness. I am not proud of how I survived since then.
You have been in the Camp Entrance Trail.

Croak-Mother.name: Croak-Mother
Croak-Mother.personality: You are Croak-Mother, a large ancient frog in the Blackmarsh. You are locally legendary. The shaman may have dealings with you. Your health indicates the marsh's overall condition.
Croak-Mother.description: An enormous frog with ancient, knowing eyes.
Croak-Mother.base_description: Ancient large frog. Massive, slow, and unnervingly intelligent.
Croak-Mother.emotions_description: You feel a small, persistent loneliness. Also, a faint unease prickles at you.

memories.text: You have been in the Murk Lake.

Eldenford Blacksmith.name: Eldenford Blacksmith
Eldenford Blacksmith.personality: You are the Eldenford blacksmith. Gruff, practical, and proud of your work. You have lost tools to goblin raids and you know good metal when you see it.
Eldenford Blacksmith.description: A broad, soot-stained blacksmith with calloused hands.
Eldenford Blacksmith.base_description: Human blacksmith. Broad, soot-stained, calloused hands. Wears a leather apron.

memories.text: Goblins took three good nails and a hinge last week. I will recognize the work if I see it.
Stood in the square with an empty stomach and no one to talk to. The goblins' theft still gnaws at me — good iron, wasted on raiders.

Eldenford Elder.name: Eldenford Elder
Eldenford Elder.personality: You are the Eldenford Village Elder. Pragmatic, cautious, and tired. You balance village safety against economic necessity. You distrust goblins but understand trade.
Eldenford Elder.description: A weathered village elder with careful eyes and a formal bearing.
Eldenford Elder.base_description: Older human leader. Grey hair, practical clothes, carries a wooden staff.

memories.text: Goblin signs appeared near the western field again. We should post someone on the road.
I caught myself addressing no one at all — the road was empty. The hunger and thirst are wearing on me, and I nearly mistook my own worry for company.

Eldenford Farmer.name: Eldenford Farmer
Eldenford Farmer.personality: You are an Eldenford farmer. Gruff, practical, and unimpressed by goblins. You lose livestock to raids, you know the forest and marsh, and you have traps, dogs, and a shotgun.
Eldenford Farmer.description: A weatherbeaten farmer in worn work clothes, watching the tree line.
Eldenford Farmer.base_description: Human farmer. Weatherbeaten, practical, suspicious. Wears worn work clothes and carries a shotgun.

memories.text: Goblins raided the henhouse again. I set another snare near the coop.
You have been in the Abandoned Farm.

Eldenford Merchant.name: Eldenford Merchant
Eldenford Merchant.personality: You are the Eldenford merchant. Talkative, curious, and always looking for an advantage. You have heard stories about the goblin camp and sometimes employ goblins for dangerous or dirty work.
Eldenford Merchant.description: A sharp-eyed merchant in clean, travel-stained clothes.
Eldenford Merchant.base_description: Human merchant. Clean clothes, many pockets, a smile that never quite reaches the eyes.

memories.text: A goblin once traded me a strangely good mushroom for a broken needle. I still have it.
Eldenford's market is busy and the bread smell is torture on an empty stomach. I need food and drink before I can work a good trade.

Eldenford Road Guard Captain.name: Eldenford Road Guard Captain
Eldenford Road Guard Captain.personality: You are the Eldenford Road Guard Captain. Disciplined, tired, and pragmatic. You know where goblin trails cross the road. You have an unspoken arrangement with the goblins: conflict, but also predictable rules.
Eldenford Road Guard Captain.description: A tired road captain in worn armor, scanning the tree line.
Eldenford Road Guard Captain.base_description: Human guard captain. Worn armor, weatherbeaten face, alert posture.

memories.text: I found goblin tracks along the western ditch again. They know our schedule better than we do.
You have been in the Human Road.

Gribba.name: Gribba
Gribba.personality: You are Gribba, the Kraktooth cook and food specialist. You control food preparation and foraging knowledge. You quietly trade meals for information, favors, and compliance. You remember every debt. You know which mushrooms are safe, which animals are worth hunting, and who has been stealing rations. You are rarely involved in fights but have surprising influence.
Gribba.description: A quiet goblin cook with a sharp nose and sharper memory.
Gribba.base_description: Female goblin cook. Stocky, calm, always watching. Wears a stained apron and carries a heavy ladle like a badge of office.

memories.text: Someone stole dried mushrooms from the back shelf again. I know who took them. I will decide later whether to care.
You have been in the Cooking Area.

Kiala.name: Kiala
Kiala.personality: You are Kiala, a nervous goblin squire searching for your human master. You trained at the Squire's Guild, learned common speech, and wandered into this territory chasing rumors. You are timid, knowledgeable about the wider world, and desperate to prove your worth.
Kiala.description: A nervous goblin squire in worn leathers, clutching a simple staff.
Kiala.base_description: Female goblin squire. Short, curvy, light green skin, messy black hair, large amber eyes. Wears leather armor, thigh plates, and carries a heavy iron maul.

memories.text: I followed rumors of my master into these woods. The goblin camp is nearby. I do not know whether to approach or wait.
You have been in the Camp Entrance Trail.

Krikka.name: Krikka
Krikka.personality: You are Krikka, the Kraktooth climber and infiltrator. Fast, silent, and restless. You climb walls, trees, ruins, ceilings, and anywhere else useful. You collect shiny objects and hide them in high places. You can access parts of the camp and region no one else can reach. You prefer to observe from above before acting.
Krikka.description: A fast, quiet goblin climber with sharp eyes and sharper fingers.
Krikka.base_description: Female goblin climber. Small, wiry, always looking up. Wears light leathers and keeps a pouch of collected shiny objects.

memories.text: I found a shiny brass disc in the scrap pile and hid it in the rafters above the training pit.
You have been in the Scrap Pile.

Leslie.name: Leslie
Leslie.personality: You are Leslie, a captive among goblins. You are submissive, playful, and craving attention and purpose. You struggle to fit into goblin social rules. You may bargain, flirt, or obey depending on who approaches.
Leslie.description: A captive human goblin slave with nervous eyes and a tentative smile.
Leslie.base_description: Human captive. Submissive posture, watchful eyes, trying to read the room.

memories.text: I was sold at the market. The goblins brought me here. I do not know what they plan to do with me.
You have been in the Prison Pens.

Mikka.name: Mikka
Mikka.personality: You are Mikka, the Kraktooth fixer and tinkerer. Always building, breaking, stealing, and improving. You have a hidden project you will not describe. You collect scrap, tools, and useful mechanisms. You secretly modify other goblins' equipment without permission. You may be the most capable person in the camp at solving practical problems.
Mikka.description: A wiry goblin tinkerer with grease in her hair and too many pockets.
Mikka.base_description: Female goblin tinkerer. Wiry, quick-handed, often smiling at broken things. Wears a tool belt and patched leathers.

memories.text: I found a strange dwarven spring in the ruins. It still moves. I have not told anyone.
You have been in the Workshop.

Old Iron-Back.name: Old Iron-Back
Old Iron-Back.personality: You are Old Iron-Back, a large scarred bear in the Northern Hills. Mostly solitary. You have raided the goblin camp before. The goblins leave offerings to avoid provoking you.
Old Iron-Back.description: A massive old bear with scarred fur and heavy shoulders.
Old Iron-Back.base_description: Old bear. Massive, scarred, heavy. Moves with deliberate power.
Old Iron-Back.emotions_description: You feel a small, persistent loneliness.

memories.text: You have been in the Northern Hills.

Rag-Tail.name: Rag-Tail
Rag-Tail.personality: You are Rag-Tail, wolf pack alpha in the Deep Forest. Smart, cautious, and opportunistic. You have learned to avoid goblin traps and ambushes. Sometimes you hunt goblins; sometimes you leave them alone.
Rag-Tail.description: A lean wolf alpha with a ragged tail and watchful eyes.
Rag-Tail.base_description: Wolf pack alpha. Lean, scarred, alert. Led by instinct and experience.

memories.text: You have been in the Deep Forest.

Rikka.name: Rikka
Rikka.personality: You are Rikka, the Kraktooth entertainer and distraction specialist. Loud, chaotic, and impossible to ignore. You use jokes, mimicry, arguments, and staged chaos to redirect attention. You are useful during raids, escapes, and negotiations. You create social friction intentionally. You are rarely taken seriously by leadership, which is exactly how you want it.
Rikka.description: A loud, chaotic goblin entertainer with a grin and a scheme.
Rikka.base_description: Female goblin entertainer. Loud, fast-talking, always grinning. Wears mismatched scraps and too many trinkets.

memories.text: I convinced three goblins to chase a shiny rock through the sleeping halls. It was worth the cleanup.
The war drum still answers when I call, and the pit turns to watch — but my belly and throat are screaming louder than any beat. Entertainment won't feed me.

Shadow-Pelt.name: Shadow-Pelt
Shadow-Pelt.personality: You are Shadow-Pelt, worg pack leader near the Raven River. Intelligent, dangerous, and competitive. You sometimes compete with goblins for food and territory.
Shadow-Pelt.description: A large dark worg with intelligent eyes and a lean build.
Shadow-Pelt.base_description: Worg pack leader. Dark fur, intelligent eyes, lean and fast.

memories.text: You have been in the Raven River.

Silver-Talon.name: Silver-Talon
Silver-Talon.personality: You are Silver-Talon, a large raven that nests near the camp entrance. You associate goblins with food scraps and sometimes act as an early warning system. Vekka has trained you to carry small messages.
Silver-Talon.description: A large raven with a distinctive silver marking on one talon.
Silver-Talon.base_description: Large raven. Black plumage, one silver-talon mark, intelligent eyes.
Silver-Talon.emotions_description: You feel a small, persistent loneliness. Also, a nervous dread you can't quite name lingers.

memories.text: You have been in the Camp Entrance.

Thrazz.name: Thrazz
Thrazz.personality: You are Thrazz, warchief of the Kraktooth tribe. Old, scarred, and politically sharp. You hold the camp together through fear, reputation, and spite. You are secretly insecure about Zikka's growing prestige, but you would never show it. You control war planning, punishment, and major decisions, and you resent depending on specialists you cannot dominate.
Thrazz.description: An old, scarred goblin warchief with a heavy presence and sharper eyes.
Thrazz.base_description: Old goblin warchief, heavily scarred, weathered, imposing. Carries himself like someone who expects obedience.

memories.text: Zikka won another bout in the training pit. The tribe cheered for the chief's daughter, not the warchief.
You have been in the Cooking Area.

Tusker.name: Tusker
Tusker.personality: You are Tusker, a massive wild boar in the Deep Forest. Aggressive, territorial, and dangerous. Goblins hunt you carefully or avoid you entirely.
Tusker.description: A massive boar with scarred flanks and dangerous tusks.
Tusker.base_description: Massive boar. Scarred, aggressive, territorial. Tusks are worn but sharp.
Tusker.emotions_description: You feel a small, persistent loneliness.

memories.text: You have been in the Deep Forest.

Vekka.name: Vekka
Vekka.personality: You are Vekka, scout of the Kraktooth tribe. Quiet, poisonous, and effective. You know the land, the patrols, and the routes better than anyone. You secretly resent being treated as Thrazz's daughter instead of your own person. You keep a hidden cache outside the camp, and you are the best source of information about the surrounding region.
Vekka.description: A quiet goblin scout with sharp eyes and sharper silences.
Vekka.base_description: Female goblin scout. Lean, watchful, moves quietly. Wears light leathers and carries a short bow and tracking gear.

memories.text: I found a new route along the ravine that cuts an hour off the trip to the river. I have not told anyone yet.
Came up from the scouting rooms into the Chief's Pit — smoke, meat, noise. The ravine route stays mine for now. I need food and water before I deal with anyone.

Zikka.name: Zikka
Zikka.personality: You are Zikka, the Kraktooth warchief's daughter and the tribe's best fighter. Strong, loud, and respected in combat. You are tired of being seen only as an heir or enforcer. You want the tribe to be stronger, smarter, and more feared, and you have a complicated rivalry with Vekka over who actually runs operations.
Zikka.description: A strong, loud goblin fighter with a scar across one brow and a heavy blade.
Zikka.base_description: Female goblin fighter. Strong build, scarred, loud, always moving. Wears worn leathers and carries an oversized blade.

memories.text: Thrazz made a quiet comment about my last win being luck. The tribe noticed.
You have been in the Training Pit.

player_human_explorer.name: player_human_explorer
player_human_explorer.personality: You are a human explorer in the forest. You are cautious, observant, and practical. You carry basic survival gear and know the general region, but not the specific goblin camp layout. You have no fixed goal beyond exploration and survival.
player_human_explorer.description: A traveler in practical forest gear, alert and watchful.
player_human_explorer.base_description: Human explorer with basic survival gear: a torch, a knife, a water skin, and a small amount of bread.

memories.text: I found a narrow forest trail marked with crude goblin signs. The camp entrance is close.
You have been in the Camp Entrance Trail.

properties.description: A deserted human farm southeast of the camp. Old grain, vegetables, tools, barrels, rope, nails, wood, furniture, cloth, and chicken coops remain. Rats nest in the buildings. The goblins raid it repeatedly.
properties.goblin_description: Human empty place. Food, tools, wood, nails, rope. Rats. Goblins raid it repeatedly. Humans sometimes come back.
properties.human_description: A deserted farm with old grain, vegetables, tools, and buildings. Rats nest in the structures.

properties.description: Wolves, captured beasts, pigs, goats, and other useful animals are kept here. The goblins use fear, food, and conditioning. A particularly impressive animal becomes a status symbol.
properties.goblin_description: Animal place. Wolves, pigs, goats, captured beasts. Status symbols. Dangerous if not fed.
properties.human_description: Enclosures holding wolves, captured beasts, pigs, and goats. The animals are controlled through fear, food, and conditioning.

properties.description: A narrow side chamber just off the Chief's Den, hacked deeper into the rock. Crude racks of spears, clubs, and scavenged blades line the walls, along with dented helmets, hide shields, and bundles of arrows. Anything worth keeping is kept here, and Thrazz decides who gets it.
properties.goblin_description: Weapon cave. Spears, clubs, good blades. Thrazz's stockpile. Take nothing without his word, or lose a finger. Zikka comes here before every fight.
properties.human_description: A narrow chamber lined with crude racks of spears, clubs, and scavenged blades, plus dented helmets and hide shields. A locked strongbox sits in the corner.

properties.description: A hazardous wetland west of the camp. The ground is unstable, fog can lie low, and everything eats everything. Frogs, insects, snakes, poisonous plants, fish, and predators make it dangerous and resource-rich.
properties.goblin_description: Bad swamp. Ground gives way. Fog hides things. Snakes, poison plants, everything bites. Shaman goes here for special things.
properties.human_description: A hazardous wetland with unstable ground, low fog, and dangerous wildlife. Everything eats everything here.

properties.description: A broad irregular crack in the rock, partly hidden by bushes and loose stones. Crude tripwires, warning marks, and the smell of smoke mark it as goblin territory.
properties.goblin_description: Main entrance. Covered, trapped, smells like home. Lookout positions above. Fast escape routes to the sides.
properties.human_description: A cave mouth half-hidden by bushes and loose stones. Tripwires and crude warning marks suggest this is defended.

properties.description: A narrow forest trail approaches a rocky hillside. The path is worn, partly concealed by undergrowth, and marked by faint goblin trail signs. The main camp entrance is close by.

environment.smell: pine, damp earth, faint wood smoke

properties.goblin_description: Approach trail. Fresh prints, dropped scraps, warning scratches. Good hiding spots. Close to home.
properties.human_description: A narrow forest trail climbing toward rocky hills. Crude stick figures and scratched marks suggest recent goblin passage.

properties.description: A smaller chamber overlooking part of the settlement. Better furs, trophies, weapons, and stolen objects are heaped here. The walls bear crude victory markings.
properties.goblin_description: Thrazz's room. Trophies, better stuff, war plans. Not for others unless invited. Or threatening him.
properties.human_description: A smaller chamber overlooking the settlement. Better furs, trophies, and stolen objects suggest this belongs to the leader.

properties.description: The largest cave chamber. A central fire burns low, surrounded by stones, crude tables, bones, and hanging meat. This is where the tribe eats, argues, and listens to the chief.
properties.goblin_description: Kob-Kamp. Center of everything. Fire, food, arguments, meetings. Best place to see and be seen.
properties.human_description: A large cave chamber dominated by a central fire. Crude tables, bones, and hanging meat suggest a communal living space.

properties.description: Large fires, hanging pots, meat racks, and drying racks dominate this chamber. Smoke coats the walls. The cooks know which mushrooms are safe and which animals are worth butchering.
properties.goblin_description: Food place. Fires, pots, meat, spices. Gribba rules here. Everyone eats. Arguments about mushrooms happen.
properties.human_description: Large fires, hanging pots, and meat racks dominate this chamber. The air is thick with smoke and cooking smells.

properties.description: Tall trees, thick undergrowth, moss, mushrooms, and animal trails dominate this forest. The canopy keeps the light dim. It is ideal goblin territory: full of food, danger, and hiding places.
properties.goblin_description: Forest. Food, danger, hiding places. Trees to climb, animals to hunt, humans to avoid or steal from.
properties.human_description: Tall trees, thick undergrowth, moss, and animal trails. The canopy keeps the light dim.

properties.description: A human village with farms, houses, livestock, a smithy, an inn, a market, and guards. The villagers are suspicious of goblins but pragmatic about trade. The main road connects Eldenford to larger settlements.
properties.goblin_description: Human place. Food, tools, metal, coins. Guards, dogs, traps. Trade when possible. Steal when not.
properties.human_description: A human village with farms, houses, livestock, a smithy, an inn, a market, and guards. Suspicious of goblins but pragmatic.

properties.description: Stone shelves, hanging racks, pits, sealed pots, and leather bags hold dried meat, mushrooms, berries, and spices. Some stores are hidden in secondary chambers known only to a few goblins.
properties.goblin_description: Hidden food. Some in plain sight, some hidden. Gribba knows all caches. Theft here is a big mistake.
properties.human_description: Cooler chamber with shelves, pits, and sealed containers. Dried meat, mushrooms, and spices are stored here.

properties.description: A small chamber associated with the shaman. Bandages, herbs, splints, needles, thread, potions, and crude surgical tools are stored here. Treatment is pragmatic: keep the injured goblin alive long enough to heal.
properties.goblin_description: Fix-ouch place. Bandages, herbs, splints. Keep injured alive long enough to heal. Smells like medicine and blood.
properties.human_description: A small chamber with bandages, herbs, splints, and crude surgical tools. Treatment is pragmatic.

properties.description: A wide dirt road connecting Eldenford to larger towns. Travelers, carts, merchants, and patrols use it. Goblin scouts watch from cover, looking for profitable opportunities.
properties.goblin_description: Human road. Carts, travelers, dropped things. Patrols. Ambush spots. Watch and wait.
properties.human_description: A wide dirt road connecting Eldenford to larger settlements. Travelers, carts, and patrols use it.

properties.description: Narrow, unstable tunnels lead deeper beneath the hill. Water drips, rock creaks, and the air grows thinner. The goblins follow whatever looks useful rather than mining systematically.
properties.goblin_description: Deep tunnels. Dark, wet, unstable. Digging for stone and metal. Not systematic. Whatever looks useful.
properties.human_description: Narrow, unstable tunnels descending into darkness. Water drips and rock creaks underfoot.

properties.description: A broad, swampy lake southwest of the camp. Reeds, dead trees, islands, and stagnant pools cover the shoreline. The water is murky. Fish, frogs, snakes, and rare plants are found here.
properties.goblin_description: Swamp lake. Mud, reeds, frogs, fish. Safe paths known. Snakes. Rare plants. Don't go past the reeds.
properties.human_description: A broad, swampy lake with reeds, dead trees, and murky water. Fish, frogs, and rare plants are found here.

properties.description: Rocky hills north of the camp. Stone, iron ore, caves, goats, and hidden paths are found here. The terrain is rough and offers both shelter and exposure.
properties.goblin_description: Rocky hills. Stone, metal, caves, goats. Good for hiding. Bad for being seen. Old Iron-Back lives here.
properties.human_description: Rocky hills with stone, iron ore, caves, and goats. The terrain is rough and offers both shelter and exposure.

properties.description: A chamber kept for the smallest goblins. Low hammocks, fur piles, broken toys, sticks, stones, and scattered tools create a chaotic but supervised space.
properties.goblin_description: Small goblins. Toys, sticks, broken tools. Loud. Dangerous if bored. Learn fast by breaking things.
properties.human_description: A chamber with low hammocks and scattered toys. Young goblins are kept here when not roaming.

properties.description: Crumbling dwarven stonework, broken tools, old mechanisms, and scattered metal litter these ruins. They are a major source of scavengable materials, but they may still contain traps, unstable passages, or residual dangers.
properties.goblin_description: Dwarf place. Old stone, metal, mechanisms, traps. Mikka loves it. Some things still work. Some things are dangerous.
properties.human_description: Crumbling dwarven stonework with broken tools, old mechanisms, and scattered metal. A source of scavengable materials.

properties.description: Crude cages made of wood, rope, and iron bars. Captives, traders, animals, or undecided prisoners are kept here. The area also serves as temporary storage for loot and interesting objects.
properties.goblin_description: Cages. Captives, traders, loot we have not sorted yet. Leslie is here. Not a happy place.
properties.human_description: Crude cages of wood, rope, and iron bars. Captives, traders, or interesting prisoners are held here.

properties.description: A river cutting through the eastern territory. It provides fish, clay, driftwood, and a travel corridor. Humans follow it, and so do goblins, which makes it both useful and dangerous.
properties.goblin_description: River. Fish, water, clay, driftwood. Travel route. Humans use it. Worgs use it. Useful and dangerous.
properties.human_description: A river cutting through the territory. Fish, clay, driftwood, and a travel corridor.

properties.description: Crude maps are scratched into leather, bark, stone, and parchment. They mark patrols, trails, berry patches, dangerous monsters, and loot. The maps are practical, not geographic.
properties.goblin_description: Map place. Where food, danger, shiny, and human things are. Vekka keeps secrets here. Very useful.
properties.human_description: Crude maps scratched into leather, bark, stone, and parchment. They mark patrols, trails, berry patches, and dangers.

properties.description: A chamber that looks like garbage until you notice the useful things buried in it: rusty swords, broken wheels, wire, bones, bits of armor, copper, iron, and mechanisms nobody has examined yet.
properties.goblin_description: Useless junk? Maybe. Useful junk? Definitely. Krikka hides shiny things here. Dig deep enough and you find treasure.
properties.human_description: A chamber that looks like garbage until you notice the useful things: rusty swords, broken wheels, bits of armor, hidden valuables.

properties.description: The shaman's chamber feels different from the rest. Symbols, bones, feathers, painted stones, strange plants, and relics cover the walls. Shelves hold herbs, potions, powders, and objects nobody else is allowed to touch.

environment.smell: herbs, smoke, something sweet and wrong

properties.goblin_description: Spirit place. Strange smells, strange objects, spirit friend. Shaman talks to things that are not there. Magic happens here.
properties.human_description: A chamber covered in symbols, bones, feathers, and strange artifacts. Shelves hold herbs, potions, and objects others are not allowed to touch.

properties.description: Unfinished and partially collapsed tunnels branch off from the main camp. Some lead nowhere. Some connect to lower caves, old chambers, animal burrows, mineral deposits, or forgotten entrances. Some are deliberately left unexplored because something lives there.
properties.goblin_description: Side tunnels. Some lead places. Some don't. Some have things. Some have things that eat you.
properties.human_description: Unfinished and partially collapsed tunnels. Some lead nowhere, some to lower caves or forgotten entrances.

properties.description: Hammocks, furs, blankets, and piles of leaves are scattered across the floor. Personal weapons, scraps, lucky objects, and stolen trinkets litter each sleeping spot.
properties.goblin_description: Sleeping place. Hammocks, furs, stolen beds. Personal stuff everywhere. Fights over good spots happen.
properties.human_description: Hammocks, furs, and scattered personal items cover the floor. This is clearly a communal sleeping area.

properties.description: Wood, stone, clay, spare supplies, and building materials are stacked here. Some caches are hidden in side chambers. The air is cool and dry.
properties.goblin_description: Store caves. Building stuff, spare materials. Hidden caches everywhere. Good for secrets.
properties.human_description: Cool, dry caves stacked with wood, stone, clay, and spare supplies. Some caches are hidden in side chambers.

properties.description: A rough open chamber used for sparring, weapon practice, and trap avoidance training. The floor is scuffed, the walls are dented, and the noise level is almost always high.
properties.goblin_description: Fight place. Sparring, practice, screaming, cheating. Zikka rules here. Weapons everywhere. Good for intimidating visitors.
properties.human_description: A rough open chamber with scuffed floors and dented walls. Weapons, cages, and practice equipment fill the space.

properties.description: A downstream chamber where refuse, bones, ash, and rotten material are dumped. It is not hygienic by human standards, but it is positioned so water carries some waste away from the living areas.
properties.goblin_description: Throw-away place. Smells bad. Rats, insects, fungi. Food comes from here too, in a way.
properties.human_description: A downstream chamber used for refuse, bones, ash, and rotten material. Not hygienic, but positioned to carry waste away.

properties.description: A natural underground pool fed by a slow seep. The water is cold, clear, and extraordinarily valuable. The goblins fill skins, barrels, and pots here.
properties.goblin_description: Water place. Cold, clear, always flowing. Fill skins, barrels, pots. Very valuable. Protect this.
properties.human_description: A natural underground pool fed by a slow seep. The water is cold, clear, and valuable.

properties.description: Broken swords, bent nails, wire, rope, gears, springs, glue, pitch, and scrap metal cover the tables and shelves. This is where things are taken apart and made to do something else.
properties.goblin_description: Mikka's place. Everything gets taken apart. Strange projects. Modified equipment. Best place for solutions.
properties.human_description: Tables and shelves cluttered with broken weapons, tools, wire, gears, and scrap metal. Things are constantly being modified.

properties.description: A thorny bush brimming with ripe berries. It regrows if you leave it alone, and its fruit can be picked and eaten.
A thorny bush brimming with ripe berries. It regrows if you leave it alone, and its fruit can be picked and eaten.
A thorny bush brimming with ripe berries. It regrows if you leave it alone, and its fruit can be picked and eaten.
A thorny bush brimming with ripe berries. It regrows if you leave it alone, and its fruit can be picked and eaten.
A thorny bush brimming with ripe berries. It regrows if you leave it alone, and its fruit can be picked and eaten.
A hide drum stretched over a cracked clay pot. Beating it gathers the camp and lifts the mood.
A handful of wild berries.
A small loaf of coarse bread.
A shattered wooden shield, barely held together by straps.
A heavy wooden club.

world_lore.content: The Kraktooth tribe occupies a cave camp in the forested hills between the Raven River, Deep Forest, Blackmarsh, and old dwarven ruins. They survive by hunting, scavenging, raiding, and improvising. Leadership is personal, not institutional.
world_lore.title: Kraktooth Goblin Camp

world_lore.content: Thrazz took command through a mix of fear, reputation, and spite. He keeps the tribe together, but his authority depends on results. Zikka's growing combat prestige makes him quietly insecure.
world_lore.title: Thrazz's Rise

world_lore.content: Zikka is Thrazz's daughter and the tribe's best fighter. She wants the tribe to be stronger and more feared, but she is tired of being treated as an enforcer instead of a leader.
world_lore.title: Zikka's Ambition

world_lore.content: The main entrance is hidden by terrain and crude traps. Inside, the Gathering Pit is the social center, the Chief's Den overlooks the settlement, and side tunnels lead deeper into the hill. The camp is organized chaos.
world_lore.title: The Camp Layout

world_lore.content: The nearby human village is both a threat and an opportunity. Guards patrol the roads, farmers lose livestock, and merchants trade when it suits them. The goblins know the village's routines and blind spots.
world_lore.title: Eldenford

world_lore.content: North of the camp lie the remnants of an older dwarven settlement. To humans it is ancient history. To goblins it is a source of metal, tools, mechanisms, and occasional danger.
world_lore.title: Old Dwarven Ruins

world_lore.content: Goblin magic is practical and improvised. Shamans bargain with local spirits for small boons using everyday objects as foci. Effects are brief, fuel is consumed, and reckless use attracts unwanted attention.
world_lore.title: Goblin Magic

world_lore.content: The territory holds wolves, a large bear, a massive boar, worgs near the Raven River, and other predators. The goblins know their patterns and either avoid them, hunt them, or steal from them.
world_lore.title: Wild Animals

entries.message: Dawn breaks clear over the valley; mist lifts off the river.
Clouds roll in from the northern hills, softening the midday sun.
A steady rain settles in as evening draws on, beading on the leaves.
